title: When using Gemini's OpenAI compatible API, request fails due to frequency_penalty parameter
body: ### 📦 Platform Self hosting Docker ### 📦 Deploymenet mode server db(lobe-chat-database image) ### 📌 Version v1.116.1 ### 💻 Operating System macOS ### 🌐 Browser Edge ### 🐛 Bug Description Gemini官方有OpenAI兼容格式进行透明代理。详情请参考官方文档：https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai 当我配置了OpenAI格式的自定义服务商，能获取到模型（这说明服务端正常工作），但对话功能返回错误 ### 📷 Recurrence Steps 点击连通性检查，lobe发送以下请求 ```shell curl 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/chat/completions' \ -H "authorization: Bearer ${GEMINI_API_KEY}" \ -H 'content-type: application/json' \ --data-raw $'{\n "stream": true,\n "frequency_penalty": 0,\n "presence_penalty": 0,\n "temperature": 1,\n "top_p": 1,\n "messages": [\n {\n "content": "hello",\n "role": "user"\n }\n ],\n "model": "gemini-1.5-flash",\n "stream_options": {\n "include_usage": true\n }\n}' ``` 响应报错： ```json [{ "error": { "code": 400, "message": "Invalid JSON payload received. Unknown name \"frequency_penalty\": Cannot find field.", "status": "INVALID_ARGUMENT", "details": [ { "@type": "type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.BadRequest", "fieldViolations": [ { "description": "Invalid JSON payload received. Unknown name \"frequency_penalty\": Cannot find field." } ] } ] } } ] ``` 删除`frequency_penalty`字段后可正常响应数据。 ### 🚦 Expected Behavior LobeChat 应该能够成功向兼容 OpenAI 格式的 Gemini API 发送请求，并正常接收和显示模型的响应。理想情况下，LobeChat 在发送请求前可以移除或忽略掉目标服务不支持的参数。 ### 📝 Additional Information 需要需要在lobe添加多个geimin服务商的源，但lobehub现在自定义服务商暂时没提供gemini格式； 就使用了gemini官方的OpenAI兼容格式，但在lobehub中发送了多余参数，gemini格式的服务也对请求参数要求严格； 解决方案建议：在LobeChat的请求构建逻辑中增加一个判断。当用户使用的是gemini兼容OpenAI模式时（可能需要增加一个额外的设置），在最终的请求体中移除frequency_penalty和presence_penalty这两个字段。 这样既能确保对 Gemini API 的兼容性，也不会影响现有对 OpenAI 或其他完全兼容 API 的使用。

linked_prs.title: 💄 style: Allow removal of `top_p` and similar request parameters
linked_prs.body: #### 💻 Change Type - [ ] ✨ feat - [ ] 🐛 fix - [ ] ♻️ refactor - [ ] 💄 style - [ ] 👷 build - [ ] ⚡️ perf - [ ] ✅ test - [ ] 📝 docs - [ ] 🔨 chore #### 🔀 Description of Change 允许通过取消勾选来避免传递 temperature 等四个参数。 - close #8957 - close #7955 - close #6314 - close #2071 - close #5203 #### 📝 Additional Information ## Summary by Sourcery Allow toggling removal of top_p and similar request parameters via checkboxes in the UI, with backend support to delete or disable those parameters and prevent sending null values to the API. New Features: - Add checkboxes to enable or disable temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, and frequency_penalty sliders in ChatInput ActionBar and Agent Modal - Extend SessionModel.updateConfig to treat undefined param values as deletions and null values as disabled markers - Convert null parameter values to undefined before sending API requests in ChatService Enhancements: - Refactor parameter controls into reusable wrapper components with consistent styling and debounce saving behavior - Adjust FORM_STYLE itemMinWidth for improved layout Tests: - Add unit tests to verify proper deletion of undefined parameters and null marking in session model

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue as it involves an incompatibility with an LLM provider (Gemini's OpenAI-compatible API) due to the inclusion of unsupported parameters (`frequency_penalty`). This aligns with the sub-category "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" under the taxonomy.
